notes_for_editor: Mostly Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted; paraphrased) and the PEI heritage statement; the Marine reports add the breakwater light, tower cost, lifeboat and 1911 wreck. Disagreements: record gives tower height 14.0 m, heritage statement says 18.5 m (60 ft); builder spelled Alyward (LHF) vs Aylward (heritage record); heritage record says automated 1961 while LHF has keepers to 1991 (story states both). The 1906 volume's page 69 text sits in a passage about fiscal 1904-5 and I did not pin the year of the steel tower's start. Fiscal years: Marine reports labelled by volume. Roster dates are LHF's list (not independently checked against the Marine keeper tables, whose OCR columns are unreliable); Francis McIntosh's assistant start year is not given. Souris also had a separate Souris West light (not covered). Fact-check: Frank McIntosh is matched to roster 'Michael Francis McIntosh' by dates only (LHF uses both names); 1907 lens date is LHF's, the Marine report only says the light was received and about to be erected.
